leadText: Kōsuke Kuwano (Japanese: 桑野 晃輔 Kuwano Kōsuke) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Kōsuke Kuwano (Japanese: 桑野 晃輔 Kuwano Kōsuke) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Kuwano was born on October 16, 1990 in , and became a voice actor as an adult. Kuwano's joined the during , where his only role was Molayne. He is currently affiliated with Sunaoka Creative Artist.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
====Pokémon the Series====
Molayne

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
===Live-action roles===
Punk Kid (Lock and Roll Forever)
Unknown (Till the Death Do Us Apart Part II)
Turbo (Sora kara kita Tenkôsei)
Unknown (Oshôkô)

===Anime series===
Souta Miki ( )
Sōichirō Suzuki ( )
Yūga Aoyama and Hiryu Rin ( )

===Theatrical roles===
Tabo (Summer of Angels)

===Video game roles===
Yūga Aoyama ( )
